run_filter_llvm_passes_cli: run the script to filter LLVM passes from stdin CSV and write selected passes to stdout
filter_passes_generator: filter an iterable of Pass objects using config.include_pass and yield only selected passes
main_entry_point: read CSV from stdin, filter LLVM passes, and write sorted results as CSV to stdout
review_filter_passes: review the filter_passes generator function that applies config.include_pass to each Pass object
summarize_main: summarize the main entry point that reads CSV stdin, filters passes, and writes sorted CSV stdout
